grow_up.description: Event to fire when an entity grows up. Can be an object with event and target properties, or a simple event string.

pause_growth.description: Event triggered when a baby entity's growth is paused (via a pause_growth_items feed).

reset_growth.description: Event triggered when a baby entity's growth is reset (via a reset_growth_items feed).

calm_event.description: Event to fire when this entity is calmed down. Can be a simple event name string or an object with event and target properties.

attack_cooldown_complete_event.description: Event to be run when the cooldown is complete. Can be an object with event and target properties, or a simple event string.

breed_event.description: Event to run when this entity breeds. Can be a simple event name string or a trigger object with event and optional filters.

dried_out_event.description: Event to fire when the drying out time runs out. Can be an object with event and target properties, or a simple event string.

recover_after_dried_out_event.description: Event to fire when entity was already dried out but received increase in water supply. Can be an object with event and target properties, or a simple event string.

stopped_drying_out_event.description: Event to fire when entity stopped drying out. Can be an object with event and target properties, or a simple event string.

on_give.description: Event to fire when the correct item is given. Can be an object with event and target properties, or a simple event string.

on_leash.description: Event to call when this entity is leashed. Can be an object with event and target properties, or a simple event string.

on_unleash.description: Event to call when this entity is unleashed. Can be an object with event and target properties, or a simple event string.

sit_event.description: Event to run when the entity enters the 'sit' state. Can be an object with event and target properties, or a simple event string.

stand_event.description: Event to run when the entity exits the 'sit' state. Can be an object with event and target properties, or a simple event string.

tame_event.description: Event to fire when the entity is tamed. Can be an object with event and target properties, or a simple event string.

on_inside_range.description: Event to call when an entity gets in the inside range. Can be an object with event and target properties, or a simple event string.

on_outside_range.description: Event to call when an entity gets outside the outside range. Can be an object with event and target properties, or a simple event string.

time_down_event.description: Event to fire when the time on the timer runs out. Can be an object with event and target properties, or a simple event string.

trust_event.description: Event to run when this entity becomes trusting. Can be an object with event and target properties, or a simple event string.

on_roar_end.description: Event that is triggered when the roar ends. Can be an object with event and target properties, or a simple event string.
